## When to use
Use when building, reimplementing, or fixing a Powerhouse document editor or drive app — the React UI that displays and edits documents of a given model in Connect.

## What it covers
- Workflow
- Common mistakes
- ED.00.1 Familiarize yourself with the document model
- ED.00.2 Scaffold the editor via the CLI (primary route)
- ED.00.3 Alternative: register through the Vetra Drive
- ED.00.4 Verify the code generation was triggered and boilerplate code was created
- ED.01.1 Verify code generation and clean up the boilerplate code
- ED.01.2 Ensure test documents exist for verification
- ED.01.3 Implement viewing functionality
- ED.01.4 Implement editing functionality
- ED.01.5 Resolve outstanding issues
- ED.01.6 Visual verification with Playwright
- Required imports and setup
- Styling
